title: Android Ledger v10 cash integrity validation
scope: Experimental Regtest Android checkout: Ledger v10 authenticated manual sale and two-stage cash commands, exact replay, cross-instance CAS, strict legacy migration, source/model validation, two-ABI package build, and disposable API 35 acceptance.

checks.name: complete checkout JVM model suite
checks.result: passed with -Werror and jvm-target 1.8; includes two-stage cash restart/replay/conflict, fresh-balance partial/full/zero application, later-evidence reopen, strict v10 codec and coverage, exact raw-byte CAS, stale writers, maximum IDs, and v2-v9 migration

checks.name: experimental checkout Android package
checks.result: passed; feature-verified native libraries packaged for arm64-v8a and x86_64, Kotlin compiled, APK dexed, aligned, test-signed, and signature-verified

checks.name: disposable API 35 Android acceptance
checks.result: passed full non-expiry suite, including prepared cash intent force-stop recovery, tender blocking, single completion and restart persistence, plus existing authority, staff, lifecycle, export, recovery and fail-closed scenarios

open_gates: Cash remains a human acknowledgment without physical note, drawer, or returned-change verification.
Bitcoin/card, refund, provider-observation, catalog, inventory, fulfillment, and cash-session linking remain unattributed compatibility or separate-module paths.
CAS protects cooperating writers but does not provide tamper evidence, rollback/ABA detection, or an external monotonic freshness anchor.
The retained-intent and command history needs authenticated checkpoint/archive design before the 1,000-intent, 4 MiB, or 5,000-command bound.
CAS/uncertain failures and late/rising provider evidence are JVM-tested, not Android fault-injected; no physical-device workflow was run.
Production card hardware/approval, mainnet, integrated Lightning, real funds, merchant shifts, and typed SYSTEM observations remain open.
claim_boundary: The evidence supports the exact test-only APK's normal API 35 two-stage manual-cash recovery workflow and the model integrity cases listed above. The 502-capability register remains unchanged.
